about: Chat-shaped questions — the third KPI set. See scripts/search-kpi/README.md, section 'The question set'. Written by an assistant from the page inventory, NOT from any ranker's output. Every `expect` URL is validated against the built index by questions.js, so a page that moves fails loudly instead of scoring 0.
rules: A query must be a question a developer would type to an assistant, not a heading.
A query must NOT reuse its target page's title verbatim — that is the exact-match case, and the artificial set already covers it.
`expect` lists every page that genuinely answers, drawn from the page inventory. Anchors are not used: the harness compares page URLs.

`/api/faq/` is listed on the 14 queries the FAQ page genuinely answers, added 2026-08-06 when the page shipped — judged by reading the answers, not by reading a ranker's output. For several of them it is now the best answer on the site, so leaving it off reported a total miss for a question answered at position 1. Deliberately NOT added where the page merely ranks well: `how do I tail the output of several services together?` (it says nothing about `imq log`), `how do I close postgres listeners cleanly on shutdown?` (nothing on enableGracefulShutdown), `do I have to expose REST between my own services?` (that argument is the blog post's, not the FAQ's), and `why did my method argument end up typed as any?` — which the FAQ answers exactly under `#why-must-removecomments-be-false-in-a-project-that-uses-imqueue`, except the ranker surfaces the *validation* answer instead and the right anchor is nowhere in the top six, so page-level credit would hide a real defect. Anchor precision is asserted in scripts/check-search-ranking.ts, which compares full URLs; this set stays page-level.
imqueue.org only. The harness skips `external` hits, so a question whose answer lives on imqueue.com cannot score here — those are asserted by scripts/check-search-ranking.ts instead.
`label` is the topic, for the macro average. One topic must not be able to carry the score.
